## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `salience-broadcast-habituation`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-08T04:59:00.593Z.

Algorithm (13) salience-gated broadcast arbitration with habituation (global-workspace competition; serves pm-vvib candidate 14). Purpose: in a workspace with thousands of concurrent agents, decide WHICH few events earn workspace-wide attention and for HOW LONG, without a daemon and without flooding every context envelope. Mechanism, three stages. Stage 1 — local salience scoring at write time: every mutation event already folds derived state (algorithm 6); the same fold computes a broadcast score as an explainable linear combination (algorithm 3) of: surprise (inverse of the event's predicted probability given co-change statistics, algorithm 12 Part A — an edit nobody's coupling history predicted scores high), blast radius (count of items/agents whose open loops (11) or claimed WIP sit inside the event's co-change + dep neighborhood), outcome severity (negativity-weighted: failure/wontfix/regression close-reasons outrank routine closes, pm-vvib candidate 7), and deadline pressure (proximity of release-gated dependents). Stage 2 — bounded workspace arbitration: a fixed-capacity broadcast set (~4 slots, human working-memory scale) maintained as a fold over the event stream (pm-e200 substrate, ADR pm-i7i4 no-daemon: arbitration re-evaluates lazily whenever any agent next assembles context); an event enters only by exceeding the weakest incumbent, and incumbents decay by ACT-R log-time activation (1) so the channel self-clears. Stage 3 — habituation / inhibition-of-return: repeated structurally similar events (same WL fingerprint class, algorithm 10) attenuate geometrically so one flaky gate cannot monopolize a slot, and an agent's acknowledgment (an ordinary immutable history event) suppresses re-serving THAT event to THAT agent while leaving it live for others — per-agent delivery state is derivable from each agent's own episodic stream, zero new authoritative state. Costs: O(1) score per mutation amortized via the existing fold; arbitration is O(slots) per context assembly; sketch-backed fingerprint classes (8) bound habituation memory at million-item scale. Explainability (3): each broadcast slot renders one line with its winning terms ("broadcast: wontfix close blocks 3 release-gated items, 2 agents in radius"). Spectrum behavior: single-agent or low-traffic workspaces never fill slot 1 above threshold — the block is absent and costs nothing; thousand-agent workspaces get coherent shared attention (no duplicated discovery, no missed cross-lane hazards) for ~4 lines of tokens per envelope. Distinct from (2) spreading activation (cue-driven, per-focus recall boost; this is cue-independent workspace-wide push), from (11) open-loop floors (persistence of MY unfinished work; this is arbitration among EVERYONE's events), and from the retrieval funnel (7) quotas (which select candidate items per source; this selects events for a dedicated always-on attention block).

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
